name: Nest Playgate
description: Calm kid catalog and parent inbox for approving Android app installs on Waydroid. Static browser UI in this app; disposition queue and adb install run in the Nest host daemon (Desktop/Nest/playgate). No third-party store, no ads.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Append-only disposition log for app install asks
data_streams.retention: until operator deletes data/requests.jsonl on the host
data_streams.description: Nest host only — not used when browsing these HTML files alone.

notes.network: UI expects same-origin API from Nest serve.sh on 127.0.0.1 — not a standalone static host.
